description: A white plastic base with two upright posts sits on the yellow tabletop in front of you, against a brown draped backdrop. The left hand reaches forward to steady the base while the right hand moves in from the right to grasp the shorter upright piece, wiggles it loose, then lifts it straight up and away; the right hand carries that removed piece down toward the foreground and sets it on the table, leaving the left hand no longer touching the base.
